threads.body: [General] This section promises guidance for both PR titles and descriptions, but every rule below concerns description structure or content; no title convention is documented. This leaves the title half of the stated PR purpose unimplemented. Please either add the intended title guidance or scope the heading and PR metadata to descriptions only.
